name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST Students
department: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department (ADW), Govt of Tamil Nadu
benefit_description: Full tuition fee reimbursement and annual maintenance allowance of up to ₹75,000 for professional and general higher education
required_documents: Bank Passbook seeded with NPCI / Aadhaar

name: Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for BC/MBC/DNC Students
department: BC, MBC and Minorities Welfare Department, Govt of Tamil Nadu
benefit_description: Tuition fees, special examination fees, and annual maintenance allowance of ₹25,000

name: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Higher Education Assurance Scheme (Pudhumai Penn)
department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department, Govt of Tamil Nadu
benefit_description: ₹1,000 monthly direct bank transfer (₹12,000/year) to encourage girls from govt schools to complete higher education
required_documents: School TC / Headmaster Certificate confirming Study in Govt Schools (Class 6-12)
Current College Student ID and Bonafide
Bank Account Details with Active DBT Linkage

name: Tamil Pudhalvan Scheme for Male Higher Education Students
department: Higher Education Department, Govt of Tamil Nadu
benefit_description: ₹1,000 monthly allowance (₹12,000/year) to assist boys from govt schools in purchasing course textbooks and academic supplies
required_documents: Proof of Study in Tamil Nadu Govt School from Class 6th to 12th
Student Bank Passbook seeded with Aadhaar

name: First Generation Graduate Tuition Fee Concession Scheme
department: Directorate of Technical / Medical Education, Govt of Tamil Nadu
benefit_description: Full tuition fee waiver of up to ₹40,000/yr for professional degree candidates where no family member has graduated
required_documents: First Generation Graduate Certificate issued by Tahsildar
Joint Declaration signed by Student and Parents/Guardian
TNEA / TN Medical Counseling Allotment Order

name: Free Education Scheme for BC/MBC/DNC (3-Year UG Degree)
department: BC, MBC and Minorities Welfare Department, Govt of Tamil Nadu
benefit_description: Complete tuition and special fee exemption of ₹15,000/year for non-professional 3-year graduation courses
required_documents: First Graduate Certificate from Revenue Department

name: State Special Scholarship for Differently Abled Students
department: Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department, Govt of Tamil Nadu
benefit_description: Comprehensive grant of ₹35,000/yr including reader allowances, assistive equipment support, and living stipend
required_documents: UDID Card / National Disability Identity Card (≥ 40%)
Medical Board Certificate signed by District Medical Officer

name: Chief Minister's Higher Education Merit Award
department: Higher Education Department, Govt of Tamil Nadu
benefit_description: Competitive academic merit stipend of ₹30,000 per academic year for top performers in state examinations
required_documents: 12th Standard Certified Marksheet with High Percentile

name: Periyar E.V.R. Nagammai Memorial Free Education Scheme for Women PG Students
department: Directorate of Collegiate Education, Govt of Tamil Nadu
benefit_description: Full tuition fee waiver up to ₹18,000/yr for female postgraduate students in Arts and Science faculties
required_documents: Undergraduate Degree Completion Certificate and Consolidated Marksheet

name: Annal Ambedkar Post Graduate Special Scholarship for SC/ST
department: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department, Govt of Tamil Nadu
benefit_description: Specialized postgraduate scholarship of ₹50,000/year for books, thesis preparation, and hostel residency for SC/ST scholars

name: Perarignar Anna Memorial Award for SC/ST District Toppers
department: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department, Govt of Tamil Nadu
benefit_description: Annual cash incentive of ₹20,000 awarded to top two rank holders in 12th board examinations from each district
required_documents: 12th Standard Marksheet with District Merit Rank Endorsement

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Religious Minorities
department: Minorities Welfare Department, Govt of Tamil Nadu
benefit_description: Direct financial aid of ₹20,000/yr for students from notified religious minority communities (Muslim, Christian, Jain, Buddhist, Sikh, Parsi)
required_documents: Marksheet of previous qualifying examination (minimum 50% marks)

name: Chief Minister's Uzhavar Pathukappu Thittam (Farmers' Children Higher Education Grant)
department: Revenue and Disaster Management Department, Govt of Tamil Nadu
benefit_description: Educational grant of ₹15,000/yr for wards of small/marginal farmers and registered agricultural laborers
required_documents: Uzhavar Pathukappu Thittam Identity Card issued by Special Tahsildar

name: Higher Education Special Scholarship for SC/ST College Hostel Students
department: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department, Govt of Tamil Nadu
benefit_description: Additional ₹22,000/year residential maintenance grant for SC/ST students residing in recognized collegiate hostels
required_documents: College Hostel Warden Certificate confirming residency

name: Thanthai Periyar Memorial Award for Polytechnic / Diploma Toppers
department: Directorate of Technical Education (DoTE), Govt of Tamil Nadu
benefit_description: Cash prize of ₹10,000 for top two rank holders among BC/MBC students in government and polytechnic colleges
required_documents: Polytechnic Semester Marksheets showing Institutional Top Rank
